posts.title: Thoughts on Hotness
posts.description: As some of you know my hobby is making toy social networks. I've been thinking of a ranking algorithm for a link sharing site. I've made a personal RSS reader out of a hacker news clone. Almost all submission are from RSS feeds. As with many things the quality of the content is often inversely proportional to the quantity.
